methods: Only table 5 present population as of 1 January 2022 is admitted. Own literal Wikidata item and KATOTTH code, attested names, state/raion and unchanged original point establish settlement identity. Official raion containment is corroboration, not a substitute for own-code identity. No community or district totals are assigned to a centre. Villages held because the separate 2001 dataset names no eligible licence; Crimea and Sevastopol held without Russian figures.
